objective: Coordinate evidence, sequencing, approval gates, and final decision.
inputs: All campaign packets, this plan, live audit exports, gate reports.
outputs: Updated launch gate, exact owner approval request if all gates pass.

objective: Verify current live state and change history for all campaigns.
inputs: Google Ads UI/API access; safe audit prompts.
outputs: Screenshots/exports for status, settings, costs, change history, product groups, ads, audiences.
blocked_changes: Any setting edit, enable, publish, budget or goal change.

objective: Apply only verified paused-draft safety edits after audit and owner approval.
outputs: Before/after screenshots; change log; rollback artifact.
allowed_changes: Budget placeholder reductions, network/location safety, URL suffix, PMax URL expansion off, purchaser exclusions, brand exclusions if verified.
blocked_changes: Enabling, budget increases, conversion-goal changes, broad product expansion, bulk negative deletion.

objective: Prove paid-ready product inclusion and margins.
inputs: Merchant Center, Shopify/growth exports, product-group export.
outputs: Offer-ID allowlist, product economics report, T-shirt economics decision.
allowed_changes: Local analysis and readback only unless separately approved.

inputs: Theme/site QA, PageSpeed reports, storefront checks.
outputs: READY_FOR_PAID URL allowlist and EXCLUDE_FROM_PAID list.
blocked_changes: Live theme/content changes unless separately requested.

objective: Prove purchase value/currency/transaction ID/dedupe and bidding goals.
inputs: Google Ads conversion gate, Shopify order/test evidence, GA4/Ads exports.
outputs: Measurement gate packet and conversion action recommendation.
blocked_changes: New Google tags, GTM purchase tracking, conversion-goal mutation without approval.

inputs: Campaign audits, brand claims evidence, product/landing allowlists.
outputs: RSA/RDA/PMax asset packs with policy notes.
allowed_changes: Draft assets and paused-only ad copy edits after approval.
blocked_changes: Unsupported claims, live activation, unapproved promotions/discounts.

objective: Run final gate and propose one limited test if all gates pass.
allowed_changes: Documentation only until owner explicitly approves exact launch.
blocked_changes: Any activation without explicit owner approval.
